title.description: Optional short heading, e.g. the file name.

message.description: One or two sentences. Max 500 characters.

severity.description: How serious this is. Drives the icon and tone the client renders.

fields.description: Key/value pairs describing one entity. 1-12 entries.

items.description: One resource shape per list. 1-50 items.

id.description: Stable identifier, NOT a URL — the client turns it into a link.

status.description: Coarse state, rendered as a status dot.

caption.description: Short note below the table, e.g. the source.

key.description: Key used to look the value up in each row.

rows.description: Objects keyed by `columns[].key`. Up to 50 rows.

series.description: 1-4 series sharing the same axes and unit.

name.description: Series name shown in the legend.

suggestedViz.description: Advisory only; the client decides the final visual form.

yLabel.description: Axis label for y, including the unit.

actions.description: 1-3 follow-ups. Put this card last in a turn.

prompt.description: The exact text injected into the composer when the user picks this action.

question.description: What the user is being asked to pick between.

data.description: JSON value injected as a frozen global for the template.

html.description: Document body rendered in a sandboxed iframe. Max 65536 characters.

libraries.description: Allowlisted local bundles to prepend. Unknown names are rejected.
